property_summary: For any successful call to the fallback function, the resulting pastBlockTime must be strictly greater than the pastBlockTime before the call; the mutant can make two calls in the same block timestamp, and after the second succeeds, the stored pastBlockTime equals the value from after the first call, violating the strictly-increasing invariant.
change_summary: Replace `require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime);` with `require(block.timestamp >= pastBlockTime);` to allow a call in the same block timestamp, changing revert conditions and thus externally observable behavior.
